summary: Expand_01 and backfill_01 sql stages completed successfully. deploy_new_01.django_migrate failed with ProgrammingError: column "customer_note" already exists, observed alongside schema showing both note and customer_note columns present in account_user.
revision_notes: The customer_note column already existed in the database from a prior incomplete migration or previous plan execution, causing Django's migration runner to raise a duplicate-column error during deploy_new.

stages.description: Add the new customer_note column if it does not already exist.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_note TEXT NULL;

stages.description: Copy note values into customer_note for rows that have not been filled.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL;

stages.description: Deploy the new‑staged version of Saleor. Code changes (model field rename, bulk‑mutation field list, staff utils input list, resolver, anonymization dict, test attribute access) are already included; the new version reads and writes customer_note exclusively.
Retire the old version of Saleor that only knows the note column. Traffic is now served exclusively by the new version.
Remove the obsolete note column since the old version is no longer running.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
